name: Kaede
source:
A young lady who unexpectedly found herself unexpectedly taking on the role of the shrine maiden following her grandmother's passing.

Since then, she has devoted a significant amount of her time to the shrine, diligently training to fulfill the responsibilities.

Despiste her efforts, deep down, she yearns to return to her normal life.
